scope: Actual two-ended C2 characteristic coordinates on every internal negative component, exact full weak matrix and density, both traces, mean, ordinary/Piola sources and complete coordinate-parameter variations.

checks.name: actual_two_branch_product
checks.evidence: Both inverse characteristic derivatives are positive

checks.name: exact_full_characteristic_Jacobian
checks.evidence: The full two-dimensional cross terms are retained

checks.name: exact_transformed_radial_coefficient
checks.evidence: This is the actual weak matrix, divided by the full Jacobian

checks.name: exact_transformed_cross_coefficient
checks.evidence: The two characteristic equations cancel the complete mixed coefficient

checks.name: exact_transformed_angular_coefficient
checks.evidence: The reference type factor is exactly -q0(T)^2

checks.name: exact_transformed_discriminant
checks.evidence: The determinant density is invariant under the two-dimensional push

checks.name: exact_hodograph_full_matrix
checks.evidence: The physical-angle time derivative is retained

checks.name: exact_hodograph_density_cancellation
checks.evidence: The full J and square-root discriminant factors cancel

checks.name: exact_hodograph_source_cancellation
checks.evidence: The original ordinary scalar source has its true physical units

checks.name: exact_source_to_raw_principal_ratio
checks.evidence: The normalized physical source is a*w*e before the second map

checks.name: exact_full_ordinary_source_factor
checks.evidence: Both branch Jacobians and both optical factors remain

checks.name: exact_fold_optical_ratio
checks.evidence: The s^(3/2) factor is removed before taking an endpoint limit

checks.name: exact_fold_Jacobian
checks.evidence: The full endpoint Jacobian has a positive finite value

checks.name: exact_fold_boundary_flux_density
checks.evidence: The endpoint conormal transforms by division by Hprime

checks.name: exact_fold_ordinary_source
checks.evidence: There is no unremoved inverse square-root singularity

checks.name: exact_fold_parameter_jet
checks.evidence: Both the actual scalar speed and the actual endpoint angle vary

checks.name: exact_complete_raw_jet_recovery
checks.evidence: The actual drift remains in h_t and cancels only in the true conormal

checks.name: exact_total_endpoint_flux
checks.evidence: The physical-angle Jacobian and the KAM angle Jacobian are both present

checks.name: exact_first_parameter_inverse
checks.evidence: All of Sigma's parameter dependence is retained

checks.name: exact_second_parameter_inverse
checks.evidence: The q0prime*T_a*T_b term is necessary

checks.name: fold_first_parameter_order
checks.evidence: D Sigma is O(s^(3/2)), while q0(T) is O(s^(1/2))

checks.name: fold_second_parameter_cross_order
checks.evidence: The complete second inverse numerator has the same vanishing order

checks.name: exact_Piola_weak_source
checks.evidence: A full vector divergence source is pushed, not replaced by a boundary jump

checks.name: exact_parameter_log_Jacobian
checks.evidence: The coordinate variation includes both divergence and transport

checks.name: exact_parameter_density_column
checks.evidence: The actual numerator is delta f - div(f V)

checks.name: exact_residual_density_first_order_system
checks.evidence: The lower-left density remainder retains the exact turning factor A0

checks.name: constant_height_translation_retained
checks.evidence: No artificial zeroth-order potential has been inserted

checks.name: actual_nonturning_quintic_shoulder
checks.evidence: The sharp shoulder comes from the actual quintic, not a hypothetical profile

checks.name: absolute_shift_is_not_relative_profile_control
checks.evidence: For Lambda>=16, a shift of one shrinking shoulder width changes q^2 by a factor >3

checks.name: finite_source_L2_change_of_variables
checks.evidence: The stated source norm keeps its explicit Jacobian weight
